answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, like a pigment bond that dyes each identity with a unique cost. One honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker must fund every fake copy, so the attack price grows with each clone. Clean agents get the stake back after the epoch; proven duplicates lose it, so the ember of fraud burns the deposit while the shared lagoon of honest agents stays intact.
